migration_guidance: Future schema changes must bump config_schema_version and provide an explicit migration note.
Unknown schema versions must be rejected instead of silently coerced.
Compatibility shims are opt-in and must preserve deterministic precedence.

fallback_behavior: If semantic mode is unavailable or misconfigured, force semantic.mode to off (safe mode).
If a feature mode value is invalid, fail validation and do not auto-enable a different backend.
If session overrides are missing, continue with repo override and user default precedence.
